english.note: This is the all-purpose term for a person who guides guests to their seats at a church, cinema, or similar venue.

examples.english: Before the show, the usher told us to turn off our phones and led us to our seats.
examples.traditional: 入場前，帶位員叫我哋熄手機，跟住帶我哋入座。
